value.rationale: The result converts a pointwise curvature estimate into an exact scale-sensitive lower bound that retains every intermediate disk radius instead of discarding that information. It strictly improves the published theorem for every nonzero direction when \(0<p<2\), becomes the exact Hilbert identity at \(p=2\), and is globally sharp on rank-one rays from the origin. Thus it identifies the sharp radial defect profile behind the coarse outer-radius theorem rather than adding a routine constant tweak.
